# Bug Report

## Instructions
Please provide as much detail as possible to help us identify and fix the issue. Attach screenshots or screen recordings if applicable.

## Steps to Reproduce
Describe step by step how to reproduce the issue.

## Expected Behavior
What did you expect to happen?

## Current Behavior
What actually happened?

## User Role
Specify your user role or account type.

## Screenshots or Screen Recording
Attach any screenshots or screen recordings to help illustrate the issue.
